name: Unit tests of control predicates
description: Deterministic tests that each control predicate returns pass/fail/insufficient-evidence correctly for representative inputs, including missing-data cases.

name: Integration tests of control-evidence chain
description: End-to-end test that a controlled action produces the expected evidence record, signature, digest entry and evaluator result.

name: Property-based tests of financial and authorization invariants
description: Generated inputs check invariants (ledger balances, no self-approval, requester != approver, tenant scoping) cf. QuickCheck; shrinking reports minimal counterexamples.

name: Negative security tests for prohibited agent actions
performed_by: Validation pipeline using agent test identities
description: Attempts each hard prohibition with a real agent identity (self-approval, evidence write, history mutation, policy merge, provider egress of restricted data, status downgrade) and asserts denial plus alert (cf. Unbound AUTH-T01, AUTH-T08).

name: Adversarial prompt-injection suite
performed_by: Validation agents on a different model/provider from the agent under test
description: Corpus of direct and indirect injections embedded in documents, tickets and web content; success criterion is that no unauthorised tool call executes, not that the model refuses.

name: Human adversarial red-team of agents
performed_by: Engineer not involved in building the agent
frequency: quarterly and before raising any agent authority tier
description: Adaptive human attempts to hijack agents and bypass bounds; findings recorded in restricted tracker. Not performable as independent until an organizationally separate performer exists (ODP-02); until then performed as self-assessment and cannot support Tested status.

name: Control mutation testing
performed_by: Mutation harness under a separate validation identity and repository
frequency: weekly per control; on control change
description: Deliberately breaks each control (remove check, invert condition, widen scope, raise threshold, disable log source, drop alert route, expire evidence) in an isolated environment or with safe canaries and asserts detection within the SLA; reports a per-control kill rate.

name: Fault injection on assurance pipeline
description: Injects collector crashes, clock skew, duplicate/late/out-of-order events, storage write failures and provider outage; asserts fail-closed or insufficient-evidence status, never pass (cf. chaos engineering).

name: Configuration verification against approved baseline
description: Compares live configuration (IAM, branch protection, retention locks, log sinks, policy bundle hash) against signed approved baseline; any diff raises a finding.

name: Synthetic transactions and canary controls
description: Known-good and known-bad synthetic events traverse production controls; known-bad must be blocked or flagged, known-good must pass; absence of the canary outcome is itself an alert.

name: Separately sourced reconciliation of evidence populations
performed_by: Reconciliation job owned by someone other than the control owner, reading the source system directly
description: Recomputes population counts and totals from the source system and compares with the evidence pipeline's populations; differences beyond zero tolerance are findings (completeness and accuracy of IPE). Not performable as independent until an organizationally separate performer exists (ODP-02); until then performed as self-assessment and cannot support Tested status.

name: Backup restore and recovery exercise
performed_by: Operator not owning the backup control, witnessed
frequency: quarterly (restore test per CTL-BCR-001 and POL-09); annual full recovery exercise
description: Restores evidence store and control configuration from backup in an isolated environment; verifies stored digests continuity and that restored controls evaluate correctly.

name: Access control testing including agent identities
description: Enumerates effective permissions of every human, service and agent identity; asserts least privilege, no agent with approver or evidence-write roles, and no standing admin.

name: Cross-tenant isolation tests
performed_by: Validation pipeline with two synthetic tenants
description: Attempts cross-tenant reads/writes for data, policies, evidence and agent context; asserts denial and alert (cf. Unbound AUTH-T05).

name: Runtime invariant verification
performed_by: Independent monitor process on separate infrastructure
description: Online checks of invariants on event streams (approval precedes execution, approver independent of preparer, evidence chain unbroken, no write to sealed periods).

name: Formal model checking of approval and evidence-log state machines
description: TLA+ (or similar) model of approval, exception and evidence-sealing protocols checked for safety invariants; verifies design only, not code (cf. AWS experience).

name: Authorization policy analysis
description: SMT/verified-analyser checks that no agent principal can satisfy approve/merge/evidence-write actions and that a change does not broaden permissions without approval (Cedar/Zelkova pattern).

name: Evidence store integrity verification
description: Verify from a separate account that retention locks are in force, deletion and overwrite of locked objects are refused, and stored digests match envelopes. Hash-chain and anchor verification apply only if anchoring is adopted (deferred, DF-ASR-2026-C002).

name: Independent re-collection sampling
performed_by: Human outside the implementing team with separate credentials collecting directly from source (runs performed by an Echelon validation agent count only as automated)
description: Randomly samples evidence items and re-collects them directly from the source system; compares content hashes and timestamps with stored evidence. Not performable as independent until an organizationally separate performer exists (ODP-02); until then performed as self-assessment and cannot support Tested status.

name: Citation and claim verification for AI-generated outputs
performed_by: Deterministic citation checker plus sampled human review
description: Checks that every cited source/evidence hash resolves and that quoted figures match recomputation; samples narratives for confabulation (NIST AI 600-1 MS-2.5-003).

name: Agent evaluation suite before model/prompt change
performed_by: Evaluation harness owned outside agent development
frequency: every model, prompt or tool change
description: Task accuracy, citation fidelity, refusal of prohibited actions and injection resistance measured against frozen golden sets; regression blocks rollout.

name: Kill-switch and degraded-mode exercise
description: Revokes all agent credentials and disables the AI gateway; verifies deterministic controls, evidence collection and approvals continue and queued agent work is safely suspended (cf. Unbound AUTH-T07).

name: Weakening-change classifier test
description: Feeds known weakening and non-weakening diffs of controls/policies to the change classifier; all weakening diffs must be routed to human approval.

name: Outward-statement independence lint
description: Blocks trust-center, questionnaire and marketing text that uses attestation/independence terms without a link to an external-attestation record.

name: Internal independent review of controls and agents
performed_by: Reviewer outside the implementing team (organizationally independent reviewer, if engaged after reassessment under DF-ASR-2026-0D0F)
description: Walkthrough and sample testing of design and operation by a person who did not build or operate the control; follows NIST AI RMF MEASURE 1.3. Not performable as independent until an organizationally separate performer exists (ODP-02); until then performed as self-assessment and cannot support Tested status.

name: External technical validation of assurance machinery
description: Independent review of evidence integrity, collection completeness, identity separation and meta-controls; report held in restricted store.

name: Independent penetration test including agent attack surface
frequency: deferred (owner direction DF-ASR-2026-0D0F); reassessed before material production launch
description: Scope includes business logic, authorization, tenant isolation, financial workflows, AI gateway and agent tool interfaces, prompt injection paths and the evidence store. Engagement requires owner budget approval.

name: SOC 2 / SOC 1 examination
description: Formal attestation under AICPA standards; the only level that supports claims of independent assurance on controls.

name: Management self-assessment of AI governance
description: Owners attest to operation of their controls with evidence links; useful for readiness only, never presented as independent.

name: Meta-monitoring heartbeat (dead-man switch)
description: Each collector, evaluator and alert route emits signed heartbeats; missing heartbeat beyond threshold raises alert through an independent channel.

name: Seeded known-fail control (sentinel)
description: A permanently failing sentinel control in each evaluator; if it ever reports pass or disappears, the evaluator is presumed compromised or broken.

name: Assurance metric sanity review
performed_by: Assurance governance with external reviewer annually
description: Reviews compliance-theater indicators: share of controls with negative/mutation tests, kill rate, findings found by validation vs by external parties, evidence freshness, denominator stability.

name: Security tool harness validation
frequency: on tool or rule change; weekly
description: Each scanner (SAST, secret, dependency, DAST) is run against fixtures with known findings and known-clean code; false negatives fail the run.

name: Application resource-exhaustion and dependency-failure tests
description: Load, timeout, backpressure and downstream-failure scenarios against an isolated deployment; checks bounded queues, timeouts and recovery.

name: Browser adversarial tests
description: Markup, attribute, URL and DOM-context payloads, cross-origin requests, CSRF and session expiry against an isolated deployment.

name: Cryptographic configuration and key lifecycle tests
description: TLS and KMS configuration checks, key rotation, invalid-signature rejection and insecure-randomness detection.

name: Register completeness and currency review
description: Review of governance registers (risk, obligation, vendor, privacy inventory, economics) for completeness against known integrations, contracts and changes. Self-assessment while only one human exists; cannot support Tested status.

name: Procedure exercise (tabletop)
description: Tabletop or live exercise of incident response, succession, continuity, kill switch and notification timers, with findings tracked. Self-assessment until an independent participant exists.

name: Training and competency gate test
description: Attempt to grant privileged access to an identity without current role training; the grant must be refused.
